name: Brakes
overview: Nikita, a thirty—year—old jerk, is torn between his ex-wife, Natasha, whose feelings for her ex-husband have not cooled down, and Vika, the current wife and mother of his child. Drugs are planted on him on the street, as a result of which he ends up in prison. As it turned out, everything was done so that instead of Nikita, who was sentenced to probation, another person would be released from the courtroom — a very similar agent of the Jonik drug mafia.
